_comment: Single source of truth for the subprocessor list. Rendered at /subprocessors and served as JSON at /subprocessors.json. Update lastUpdated and give customers 30 days' notice (DPA section 6) BEFORE adding or replacing an entry. Fields marked operatorConfirm must be verified against your real contracts/deployment before launch.

subprocessors.name: Anthropic, PBC
subprocessors.purpose: LLM inference: generates plans, code patches and reviews for each workflow step.
subprocessors.data: Task prompts, relevant repository file contents and excerpts, prior error/test output, agent outputs.
subprocessors.usedWhen: Every workflow step, unless the tenant brings its own Anthropic key (enterprise BYOK), in which case Anthropic acts under the tenant's own agreement.
subprocessors.providerRetention: Governed by Aegis's commercial agreement with Anthropic. Aegis zero-retention mode controls what Aegis stores, not what Anthropic retains.

subprocessors.name: OpenAI, L.L.C.
subprocessors.purpose: Text embeddings (text-embedding-3-small) for vector memory, so agents can recall similar past fixes.
subprocessors.data: Step descriptions and search queries derived from tasks. Not sent for tenants in zero-retention mode.
subprocessors.usedWhen: Only when vector memory is enabled (OPENAI_API_KEY configured) and the tenant is not in zero-retention mode.
subprocessors.providerRetention: Governed by Aegis's API agreement with OpenAI.

subprocessors.name: Stripe, Inc.
subprocessors.purpose: Payment processing, subscriptions and metered-usage billing.
subprocessors.data: Account email, billing contact, payment details (entered directly with Stripe, never stored by Aegis), usage counts (runs, steps, tokens, sandbox minutes). No task or code content.
subprocessors.location: United States and other Stripe regions

subprocessors.name: Render Services, Inc.
subprocessors.purpose: Application hosting, Redis (workflow, job, trace and memory state) and Postgres (usage log).
subprocessors.data: All content processed by the service, at rest, encrypted by the hosting provider.
subprocessors.location: Region selected at deployment (not pinned in the default render.yaml).
subprocessors.usedWhen: Hosted Aegis service. Self-hosted customers run their own infrastructure and this entry does not apply.
subprocessors.providerRetention: Data is deleted from Aegis stores per the retention policy; provider backups follow the provider's schedule.

subprocessors.name: Amazon Web Services, Inc. (SQS)
subprocessors.data: Queued step payloads (step description and ids) in transit between server and workers.
subprocessors.usedWhen: Only when QUEUE_BACKEND=sqs. The default queue backend is Redis.
subprocessors.providerRetention: Messages are deleted on processing; SQS maximum retention applies to undelivered messages.

customerDirectedIntegrations._comment: Not subprocessors: the customer connects their own account and directs Aegis to read/write their repositories.
